comment: Routing probes for ordinary Rust work, focused specialists, and adjacent development workflows.

queries.query: Fix the lifetime error in src/parser.rs without cloning every token, and keep the public parser API stable.
Add an optional serde feature to this Cargo workspace without changing the default build or MSRV.
Use $rust-development to review this Result-based Rust API and implement the correction.
Add a subcommand to this Rust CLI that imports a CSV of orders, validates each row against the existing order rules, and writes a summary report.
Audit the entire Rust repository for every unwrap, expect, indexing panic, and poisoned-lock panic, then produce a report only.
Design a trunk-based branching and release policy for our Rust repository; no Rust code or Cargo files will change.
Design a language-neutral red-green-refactor test workflow; do not inspect or change Rust code or tooling.
Fix a Tokio task that leaks work after request cancellation and preserve the crate's existing error API.

Fix a synchronous Rust std::thread worker pool built entirely on the standard library: its bounded channel and Arc<Mutex<State>> shutdown can deadlock, worker failures disappear, and every worker must be joined.
